overview_description.description:
Cadre is an online marketplace that connects investors and operators of real estate. 

It enables investments and transactions, provides a sophisticated technology product for managing processes, and powers predictive analytics for its investors. Investors are able to sell their interest on the secondary marketplace thereby introducing liquidity into an antiquated industry. They are able to gain transparency, efficiency, and liquidity through the use of its proprietary technology, and are able to make better, more data-driven decisions. 

Founded by Ryan Williams, Cadre was launched in 2014.
